Name: Elizur, Son of Shedeur
Summary: Elizur, son of Shedeur, was the prince of the tribe of Reuben at the census in the wilderness.
KeyStory: Elizur led Reuben's 46,500 men and brought the tribe's offering for the dedication of the altar.
LifeLesson: God counts His people tribe by tribe — no one is lost in the crowd.
